story.body: You opened the almanac at the lodging and found no feast on the day. You did not add one.

title: Read the day's leaf in the almanac

participation.context: Agreed the almanac was blank, and left the vault for another day.

participation.context: Refused a second sermon, and named dinner at threepence.

participation.context: Held to yesterday's one glass, and would not write a feast in.

participation.context: Left the Monday ink for Monday, and set three trenchers.

participation.context: Sat his pew. He did not speak, and no sword-bearer stood behind him.

story.body: You heard Master Thwaite decline to write All Souls into the book. You did not hail Sir John. You went in to a threepenny dinner, and you did not start the tomb.
